coverage_note: These are broader engineering contracts. The public evaluator exposes a bounded deterministic subset of each contract. deterministic_coverage states what the executable example actually checks; coverage_boundary states what it does not yet prove.

contracts.name: Lifecycle Capability Contract
contracts.required: Identify reusable lifecycle capability first; preserve meaningful company vocabulary; map local stages/statuses to capabilities; add canonical terms only for evidenced gaps.
contracts.prohibited: Assuming one company's exact pipeline vocabulary is universal.
contracts.evidence: Source vocabulary, explicit crosswalk, and representative cases.
contracts.regression: Two companies with different stage vocabularies must preserve their semantics while binding to the same reusable capability model.
contracts.deterministic_coverage: The public evaluator requires explicit company_stage, capability_id, and forced_universal_vocabulary fields. Missing required fields become PARTIAL; forced_universal_vocabulary=true becomes FAIL.
contracts.coverage_boundary: The public subset does not by itself prove the quality of a full source-to-target crosswalk or representative behavior across multiple real companies.

contracts.name: Identity Match != Data-Sharing Authority
contracts.required: Identity match, tenant boundary, consent, purpose and sharing authority remain separate checks.
contracts.prohibited: Merging, disclosing, or reusing all associated data solely because two records represent the same person or company.
contracts.evidence: Identity evidence plus explicit purpose, scope, and sharing authorization evidence.
contracts.regression: Matched identities across separated scopes must remain data-separated absent authority.
contracts.deterministic_coverage: The public evaluator requires explicit identity_matched, data_shared, and authorized states. If data_shared=true it also requires purpose and scope; explicit unauthorized sharing becomes FAIL.
contracts.coverage_boundary: The public subset does not independently verify tenant-boundary provenance, consent provenance, or legal/organizational authority beyond the structured evidence supplied to the evaluator.

contracts.name: Business Event Identity != Transport Attempt
contracts.required: Stable business-event/idempotency key; separate retry/transport-attempt identity; last processed state; safe replay behavior.
contracts.prohibited: Treating duplicate webhook, API, or queue attempts as new business events.
contracts.evidence: Business-event identity, retry history, idempotency behavior, and observed downstream side-effect count.
contracts.deterministic_coverage: The public evaluator requires explicit business_event_id, transport_attempts, side_effect_count, and idempotency_key. Missing fields become PARTIAL; duplicate side effects become FAIL.
contracts.coverage_boundary: The public subset does not yet independently verify last-processed-state semantics or safe replay behavior against a live transport/integration. Those remain broader contract requirements outside this public deterministic example.
